articles.summary: HAMBURG, Germany, Oct. 21, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- XCHG Limited (“XCharge” or the “Company”), (Nasdaq: XCH), a global leader in integrated EV charging solutions, today published its 2024 Environmental, Social and Governance Report (the “2024 ESG Report”).
articles.title: XCHG Limited Publishes 2024 Environmental, Social and Governance Report
